answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to commit capital into a secure vault to participate in network governance. By tying identity to economic scarcity, an attacker must acquire a massive ocean of tokens to manipulate consensus, a feat that would rapidly inflate the asset price and bankrupt the adversary. This mechanism functions like a lotus bloom, where only those deeply rooted in the protocol’s value can exert influence, rendering the cost of identity replication prohibitive.
